title: Regularity after finite purely inseparable base change
statement: Every finite purely inseparable base change of the generic formal fibre is a regular ring.

proof.text: This is a named intermediate obligation extracted from the corresponding clause of Proposition 07PS. Its proof is left for a subsequent worker; the parent theorem combines it with the other clause.
